notes.message: the value "repo:octo-org@*/*" on sub is compared as written: AWS's condition operators table gives StringEquals as "Exact matching, case sensitive", so each "*" it holds is the character, not a wildcard, and the value matches only a sub that is exactly this text; StringLike is the operator that reads * and ? as wildcards
